tools.description: Redistribute the channel histograms.

tools.description: Soften pixels with a Gaussian kernel.

tools.name: Box Blur
tools.description: Average pixels inside a square neighborhood.

tools.name: Median
tools.description: Remove isolated specks using a median neighborhood.

tools.name: Sharpen
tools.description: Sharpen local edges with a convolution kernel.

tools.name: Unsharp Mask
tools.description: Sharpen detail using a blurred contrast mask.

tools.name: Emboss
tools.description: Create a directional raised relief.

tools.name: Find Edges
tools.description: Extract high-contrast edges.

tools.name: Contour
tools.description: Trace image boundaries with a contour kernel.

tools.name: Detail
tools.description: Enhance fine local detail.

tools.name: Smooth
tools.description: Smooth pixels with a weighted kernel.

tools.name: Smooth More
tools.description: Use a wider weighted smoothing kernel.

tools.name: Minimum
tools.description: Spread the darkest neighboring pixels.

tools.name: Maximum
tools.description: Spread the brightest neighboring pixels.

tools.name: Mode
tools.description: Replace pixels with the most common neighbor value.

tools.name: Edge Enhance
tools.description: Increase local edge contrast.

tools.name: Brightness
tools.description: Lift channel brightness by 25 percent.

tools.name: Contrast
tools.description: Increase contrast around the image's middle tone.

tools.name: Saturation
tools.description: Strengthen chroma without changing geometry.

tools.name: Warm
tools.description: Raise red and gently reduce blue.

tools.name: Cool
tools.description: Raise blue and gently reduce red.

tools.name: Red Isolate
tools.description: Keep the red channel and suppress green and blue.

tools.name: Green Isolate
tools.description: Keep the green channel and suppress red and blue.

tools.name: Blue Isolate
tools.description: Keep the blue channel and suppress red and green.

tools.name: Duotone
tools.description: Map luminance between the background and foreground colors.

tools.name: Threshold
tools.description: Separate luminance into black and white.

tools.name: Gamma Light
tools.description: Lift shadows with a nonlinear gamma curve.

tools.name: Gamma Dark
tools.description: Deepen midtones with a nonlinear gamma curve.

tools.name: Rgb Cycle
tools.description: Rotate red, green and blue channels.

tools.name: Red Blue Swap
tools.description: Exchange red and blue channel information.

tools.name: Vignette
tools.description: Shade the corners with an elliptical falloff.

tools.name: Chromatic Shift
tools.description: Offset red and blue in opposite directions.

tools.name: Pixelate
tools.description: Replace local blocks with their sampled color.

tools.name: Halftone
tools.description: Convert luminance into variable-size printed dots.

tools.name: Scanlines
tools.description: Alternate shaded horizontal scan lines.

tools.name: Grain
tools.description: Add deterministic monochromatic film grain.

tools.name: Bloom
tools.description: Blend a screened blur into highlights.

tools.name: Oil Paint
tools.description: Combine median texture with increased saturation.

tools.name: Pencil Sketch
tools.description: Extract a light monochrome contour sketch.

tools.name: Sobel
tools.description: Compute horizontal and vertical gradient magnitude.

tools.name: Relief
tools.description: Combine opposite directional derivatives.

tools.name: Glow
